Axiom:
Create or edit only this phase's `Target Files`; remove only exact paths declared under `Deleted Files` (exact `unlink` for an entry, then exact `rmdir` for a declared emptied directory). `Deleted Files` are tombstones, never repair targets. Reading other files (specs, sibling-phase code, rule files cited in this phase's Rules list) is allowed and expected.
The ticket is orchestrator-owned state, not a phase Target File. The worker MUST NOT manually edit the ticket, `Phases Overview`, `Execution Log`, Handoff placeholder, or DONE line. The exact `sdd-verify --task ... --phase ...` facade alone owns attempt evidence. Additionally, `sdd-log line | blocker | resolved | decision` may persist this exact ticket/phase's facts through their bounded CLI transitions; agent-produced free text uses file-backed payloads. These calls never grant new targets or authority, complete the phase, or accept a deviation. After Verify passes, return a typed Handoff; the orchestrator validates it and closes the phase through `sdd-log complete`.
Any other write or deletion → `H_OUT_OF_PHASE_WRITE`. An unusable CLI result is returned as a tool-contract blocker; it never authorizes reading bundled CLI source. Operator decides via re-planning or a new task.
